title: 2 - Skyline VIEWS - The Music City Collection
description:
LOCATION At this centrally located gem, attractions like the Johnny Cash Museum, the Country Music Hall of Fame, and the Ryman Auditorium are all just about a mile away, and in-between is your pick of cafes, craft breweries, local bars and music venues in Nashville! 

STR Permit #2018043248

The space
Surrounded by coffee shops, eateries, galleries, museums and local music, our new 3-level house is the perfect place for your Nashville stay. INSIDE THE HOUSE Sleek, modern, and decorated in a soothing color palate. This new house boasts beautiful hardwood floors and lots of windows. Your group of 10 can spread out in an open-concept main living area with easy flow between rooms.  The first level of the home has two bedrooms with queen over queen bunk beds and full bath.  The second level consists of the main living areas with an open floor plan from dining to kitchen, and living area with a half bath.  The living room sectional is a sleeper. The third level consists of a suite with King Beds and large bath.  There is an additional half bath in the hallway leading to the rooftop. Up the third set of stairs you will arrive to the expansive rooftop!  There is a fire table and grill on the rooftop to enjoy.  Guests are responsible for cleaning the grill after use and replacing the fire table cover.

Guest access
Guest have access to the entire house and private rooftop.  There is a parking pad and free street parking surrounding the home.
